nodes.summary: The sticky kernel depends continuously on the persistence.
nodes.title: Continuity of the sticky kernel in the persistence

nodes.summary: Two-state ancestry covariance (the local-ancestry chain of a two-way pulse admixture). With ancestry proportions `π = (α, 1 - α)` and persistence `c = (1 - r) ^ n` (no recombination between the two sites along the `n` meioses since admixture, recombination fraction `r` per meiosis), the indicators `I_x = [X = 0]`, `I_y = [Y = 0]` of ancestry `0` at the two sites have covariance `α (1 - α) (1 - r) ^ n`. The kernel…
nodes.title: Two-state ancestry covariance

nodes.summary: If `(X, Y)` has joint law `P(X = i, Y = j) = π i K i j` (stationary start, one step of the kernel), then `Cov(f X, g Y) = c Cov_π(f, g)`. The algebraic identity holds for all real `π`, `f`, `g`, `c`; it is a covariance of a probability law when `π` is a probability vector and `0 ≤ c ≤ 1`.
nodes.title: Covariance under the sticky kernel

nodes.summary: With `∑ π = 1`, `exp (t • κ (𝟙 πᵀ - 1)) = K (e^{-κ t})` for all real `κ` and `t`.
nodes.title: The sticky kernel is the equal-input transition function

nodes.summary: Entrywise form of the equal-input matrix.
nodes.title: Entries of the equal-input matrix

nodes.summary: With `∑ π = 1`, `𝟙 πᵀ` is idempotent.
nodes.title: Equal-input matrix is idempotent

nodes.summary: The equal-input generator `κ • (𝟙 πᵀ - 1)` with rate `κ` (Felsenstein's F81 model on an arbitrary finite state space): jumps at rate `κ` to a state drawn from `π`.
nodes.title: Equal-input generator (F81 model)

nodes.summary: The equal-input matrix `𝟙 πᵀ`: every row equals `π`.
nodes.title: Equal-input matrix

nodes.summary: For `κ ≥ 0`, `π ≥ 0` and `∑ π = 1`, the equal-input generator is a rate matrix.
nodes.title: Equal-input generator is a rate matrix

nodes.summary: Entrywise form of the sticky kernel.
nodes.title: Entries of the sticky kernel

nodes.summary: Semigroup law of the sticky kernel in time: `K (e^{-κ s}) * K (e^{-κ t}) = K (e^{-κ (s + t)})` (with `∑ π = 1`).
nodes.title: Semigroup law

nodes.summary: For `0 ≤ c ≤ 1`, `π ≥ 0` and `∑ π = 1` the sticky kernel is row-stochastic.
nodes.title: Sticky kernel is row-stochastic

nodes.summary: With `∑ π = 1`, `K c * K c' = K (c c')` for all real `c`, `c'`.
nodes.title: Composition

nodes.summary: For `0 ≤ c ≤ 1` and `π ≥ 0` the entries of the sticky kernel are nonnegative.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the sticky kernel

nodes.summary: The sticky kernel at persistence `1` is the identity.
nodes.title: Sticky kernel at persistence one is the identity

nodes.summary: With `∑ π = 1`, `K c ^ n = K (c ^ n)`: `n` steps of the sticky kernel are one step with persistence `c ^ n`.
nodes.title: Powers of the sticky kernel

nodes.summary: `π i K i j = π j K j i` (detailed balance), for all real `c`, `π`.
nodes.title: Reversibility

nodes.summary: The sticky kernel at persistence `0` is `𝟙 πᵀ`.
nodes.title: Sticky kernel at persistence zero is the equal-input matrix

nodes.summary: The sticky kernel with persistence `c`: `c • 1 + (1 - c) • 𝟙 πᵀ`. Started from `i`, it stays at `i` with probability `c` and otherwise redraws the state from `π`.
nodes.title: Sticky kernel

nodes.summary: With `∑ π = 1`, the rows of the sticky kernel sum to `1` (for every real `c`).
nodes.title: Rows of the sticky kernel sum to one

nodes.summary: `K (e^{-κ t}) → 1` as `t → 0`, for every real `κ`.
nodes.title: Short-distance limit

nodes.summary: With `∑ π = 1`, `π` is a stationary vector of the sticky kernel: `π K = π`.
nodes.title: Stationary vector of the sticky kernel
